_README: Atom-index tuples from Fig. 1a of ADAPT-GQE (arXiv:2607.22468). ONLY valid if your atom ordering matches the paper's Fig. 15 geometry (heavy atoms indexed 0-20 in that exact traversal order). If you built your geometry via mol_to_lammps_data.py --smiles, RDKit's atom ordering will almost certainly differ -- inspect your own <output>.idx.txt and redefine these tuples for your actual indices before trusting this file.
